title: Faculty Info Professor of Education, Emeritus Degrees Ed.D., Harvard University, (1976)
bio: Learning is the answer, schooling is the problem. Learning environments should be designed around strong theories of learning, rather than conventional ideas about whats good for learners or bureaucracies. The future of learning is in the hands of learners, not the adults already in the system.
research_interests: With deep expertise that connects research
